    # Chebyshev differentiation matrix
    # Using the standard formula
    c = np.ones(N)
    c[0] = 0.5
    c[-1] = -0.5
    c = c * (-1) ** np.arange(N)
    
    X = np.tile(x, (N, 1))
    dX = X - X.T
    D = (c[:, None] / c[None, :]) * (1 / (dX + np.eye(N)))
    D = D - np.diag(np.sum(D, axis=1))
